greeting: Igama likaYise, nelikaNdodana, nelikaMoya Oyingcwele. Makube noxolo nenceba kaThixo uSomandla kulo lonke ibandla lenu namhlanje.
penitential:
Nkosi, wena ungumthombo wobomi nokuqonda, sikhokele – Nkosi, yiba nenceba.
Kristu, wena ungumoya ophilisayo ozisa ukukhanya emnyameni – Kristu, yiba nenceba.
Nkosi, wena uligugu labantwana bakho bonke abaphumle kuwe – Nkosi, yiba nenceba.
psalm_response: Ndincede, Nkosi, ngokubona kwakho okukhulu, kuba uthando lwakho alunamkhawulo.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu wokuhlwa xa bonke abantu basekhaya behlala phantsi kwetafula elikhanyisiweyo, benandipha ukudla kunye nencoko emnandi, njengaloo mzuzu apho uBenjamin Vowayehleli noRyan nobazali bakhe becoca ngokudla okumnandi neeboba teas phantsi kodonga olutyheli. Kuloo mizuzu, akukho nto ibonakala ingxamisekileyo; ihlabathi lizolile, kwaye usapho lumanyene. Kodwa kwizihlandlo ezininzi, ubomi buye busithi qhuba, busibeke phambi kwezinto ezingaqhelekanga. Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo, uYohane usibonisa umbono ongaphezu kwalo mhlaba: usibonisa umlambo wamanzi aphilisayo, ocwecwe njengekristale, ophuma esihlalweni sobukumkani bukaThixo naseWundwini. Kulo mlambo, kukhula umthi wobomi ovelisa iziqhamo ngenyanga ngenyanga, kwaye amagqabi awo angamayeza ezizwe. Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Amagqabi angamayeza ezizwe. Asiyonto encinci leyo xa ucinga ngomzimba obuthakathaka, nangezifo eziye zithathe abo sibathandayo ngaphandle kwemvume yethu.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthetha amazwi aqinileyo kubafundi bakhe: 'Qaphelani ukuba iintliziyo zenu zingabi nzima ngokutywala, nokunxila, nangamaxhala obomi, ukuze loo mhla ungabanjiswa njengesibibitho.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Isibibitho sobomi. Amaxesha amaninzi, iintlungu ziza njengesibibitho; zikubamba ungazisanga, zikushiya ungenandlela yakubalekela kuyo. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyanga emihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, ikhaya lenu alisasifumani eso sikhanyiso sasisenziwa nguBen ehleka kwaye ebuza imibuzo malunga nezinto ezintsha. Ndiyazi ukuba uRyan naye ukhumbula umntakwabo owayemi ecaleni kwakhe, lowo wayenemibono emikhulu yezinto ezizayo. Intlungu yokumka komntwana wakho ayisosiqwenga sephepha ongasibeka ecaleni; ngumthwalo onzima ovakala kwizinto ezincinci, njengezihlangu ezisasecaleni komnyango, okanye indawo engenanto etafuleni.

Kodwa namhlanje, ndifuna ukuthatha elo litye elinzima lokuzisola nilithwale ezintliziyweni zenu, ndize ndilihambise kude. Alan noThao, akukho ntwana eniyenzileyo okanye eningayenzanga eyabangela ukuba uBen agule. Isifo se-AML asisisiqhamo samacingo enu, asisisiqhamo sokungakhathali. UThixo akakubeki icala, noBen ngokwakhe akakubeki icala. UBen wayeyazi indlela eniyithanda ngayo, kwaye ukwazile ukuhlala enomxholo wothando lwenu de kwaba ngumzuzu wokugqibela. Khumbula loo mzuzu Benjamin omncinci, eneminyaka nje elishumi elinesihlanu, wathetha nabazali bakhe ethesha ngelifuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yasebhange yakhe ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo ezimbini. Wayengayiphulanga loo ngulube yemali, kwaye yayingafuneki ngenxa ye-insurance, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yomntwana onobubele obungenamkhawulo — umntwana owayesolwela abanye ngaphambi kokuba azicingele yena.

Kwaye apha, ndifuna ukuthetha nawe Ryan, mfowethu omncinci. Ndiyazi ukuba ihlabathi lakho litshintshile, nokuba iklasithi yakho kunye nezinto ebe nivame ukuzenza zingenanto ngaphandle kwakhe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ngaphakathi kuwe, kukhumbuzo lothando lwenu, kwiintsuku ezinzima nasezikhanyayo. Njengokuba abangane benu babhala ukuba amawaka eenqwelo-moya ozithandayo zakha zihlale phakathi kwenhliziyo yenu, uBen umi apho kuThixo, ekhokela i-'con chim airlines' yakhe phezulu kunini ngaphambili, ekhazimla ngolwazi lwakhe lwezibalo nolwezulu.

Ngoko ke, masiyisuse ixhala kwiintliziyo zethu namhlanje. UYesu usixelela ukuba sibe ngabaphaphileyo, singoyiki, kodwa thina simi phambi koSonomntu ngentliziyo ezolileyo. UBen uphumle kakuhle ezandleni zikaThixo. Akusekho zintlungu, akusekho zifo, kwaye akusekho busuku apho. Masihambe namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba uthando alufa, kwaye uBen usalinda thina bonke phezulu ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo olunezibiyeli zamazinyo. Amen.
petitions: Sikhuleke kuThixo ukuba amkele uBenjamin Vo kunye nabo bonke abemkileyo ekukhanyeni kobuso bakhe.
Sikhuleke kubazali bakaBen, kuRyan, nakuzo zonke iintsapho ezibandezelekileyo, ukuba uThixo abaphe amandla nethemba.
standing_petitions: Nkosi, wena ungumqambi wethu, yiba nenceba kuBenjamin Vo nakubo bonke abasishiyeleyo, ubakhokele ekukhanyeni kwakho okunaphakade.
Nkosi, thuthuzela abo balila namhlanje, ubanike uxolo oludlula konke ukuqonda.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: U-Yohane wathi: Ingelosi yandibonisa umlambo wamanzi obomi, ocwecwe njengekristale, ophuma esihlalweni sobukumkani bukaThixo naseWundwini, phakathi kwesitalato saso. Ngapha nangapha kommlambo kwakukho umthi wobomi, ovelisa iziqhamo zabo kabini ngonyaka, ngasinye sivelisa isiqhamo saso ngenyanga; namagqabi emithi ayengamayeza ezizwe. Akukho nto izisiweyo emcanicwenieya kuphinda ifumaneke. Isihlalo sobukumkani bukaThixo naseWundwini siya kuba kuso, nabakhonzi bakhe baya kukhonza yena. Baya kubona ubuso bakhe, negama lakhe liya kuba ngasebunzi labo. Ubusuku abuyi kubakho kwakhona, abayi kusidinga ukukhanya kwesibane okanye kwelanga, kuba iNkosi uThixo iya kubakhanyisela, baya kuba ngukumkani ngonaphakade naphakade. Wathi kum: 'La mazwi anokuthenjwa ayinyani; iNkosi, uThixo womoya wesiprofeto, ithume ingelosi yayo ukuba ibonise abakhonzi bayo izinto ezimele kwenzeka kamsinya.' 'Khangela, ndiyeza kamsinya.' Woyisiwe ngentsikelelo lowo ugcina amazwi wesiprofeto sale ncwadi.

readings.label: Ivangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: 'Qaphelani ukuba iintliziyo zenu zingabi nzima ngokutywala, nokunxila, nangamaxhala obomi, ukuze loo mhla ungabanjiswa njengesibibitho phezu kwenu. Kuba uya kubafika bonke abahlala ebusweni bomhlaba wonke. Phaphani ngamaxesha onke, nikhuleke ukuba nibe namandla okuphunyuka kwezi zinto zonke ezizayo, nokuba nime phambi koSonomntu.'

spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukho kwiSakrament Eyingcwele yaseAltar. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwento zonke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba nawe emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingakwazi ngoku ukuba ndikwamkele kwiSakrament yobungcwele, nceda uze kum ngokomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ufikile, ndizibopha kuwe ngokuphelele; musa ukundivumela ukuba ndahlukane nawe naphakade. Amen.
closing: Makube noxolo lukaThixo olugqithisa konke ukuqonda olunegunya ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje nangaphakade. Amen.
day: Saturday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Sad
pet_prayers.text: Miss you kid! We are in Taiwan right now. Thinking of you everywhere we go. Mom cries almost every day over here

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
